
{{alias}}()
    Returns an accumulator function which incrementally computes a sample
    covariance, ignoring `NaN` values.

    If provided input values, the accumulator function returns an updated
    sample covariance. If not provided input values, the accumulator function
    returns the current sample covariance.

    If an input value is `NaN`, the input pair is ignored and the accumulated
    value remains unchanged.

    Until at least two valid data pairs have been provided, the accumulator
    function returns `null`.

    Returns
    -------
    acc: Function
        Accumulator function.

    Examples
    --------
    > var accumulator = {{alias}}();
    > var v = accumulator()
    null
    > v = accumulator( 2.0, 1.0 )
    null
    > v = accumulator( NaN, 5.0 )
    null
    > v = accumulator( 4.0, 5.0 )
    4.0
    > v = accumulator()
    4.0

    See Also
    --------
